integrity: The factorization and parametrization are proved symbolically from the published involution formula and Cayley--Menger determinant. Exact computation checks those identities and one strict geometric witness; it is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The algebraic fixed-locus description assumes nonzero coordinates. Geometric realization additionally requires positivity and Euclidean inequalities; only an open rational family around the displayed witness is asserted geometric. No quotient classification under vertex relabeling or the larger generated group is claimed.
title: The fixed locus of the Heegner quadrilateral involution has a rational conic component
